title: As AI eats the web, the internet’s collective memory is disappearing
summary: This article examines how Google Search quality is declining as AI-generated content proliferates across the web, threatening the internet's traditional collective memory and knowledge preservation. The piece argues that as AI increasingly consumes and replaces human-created content online, reliable information sources are becoming harder to find.
problem_solved: Highlights the growing problem of information degradation as AI-generated content replaces authentic human knowledge on the internet.
why_valuable: Raises critical awareness about the erosion of digital knowledge quality and the need to preserve reliable human-generated content online.
